requirements.location: Entire current frozen report lines 1–341, seven substantive sections, all market/platform/value-flow/sensitivity/regulatory/decision tables and complete citation definitions.
requirements.basis: Actually read this English original task, effective requirements and complete report without coordinator or peer comments; did not treat the Chinese report as evidence or require matching conclusions. Section 1 defines microdrama and a domestic final-demand perimeter, distinguishes top-ups/consumption, intermediary receipts, trade value and net bases, and explains incompatible historical estimates and forecasts. Section 2 separates national population, channel unions/overlap, app activity, time/frequency, payment intentions versus conversion, and ad monetization; it identifies missing national decomposition inputs. Section 3 selects platform mechanisms and explains recommendation/search, acquisition/organic/return, ownership of the viewing relationship, exclusive windows, rights and contracts, with growth/decline and reward-adjustment cases and audience/content confounding. Sections 4–5 trace recognition, cost and cash responsibility; bounded company cases and fully specified paid/free/hybrid examples reconcile money and cover budgets, acquisition, refunds, shares, continuation and retention without assuming industry margins. Section 6 addresses filing/review, copyright, minors, refunds and dated platform rules. Section 7 gives separate platform, producer, distributor and investor choices with contrary evidence and reversal conditions. English readers receive explanations of mini-program, touliu, fenzhang, baodi, beian and IP; source locations and final link definitions are present, and overseas/cumulative/forecast boundaries remain intact. No required substantive deliverable is missing.
